cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check all nginx configs that reference arelorian.de
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -l 'arelorian' /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*")
print("Configs:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check DNS
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("dig +short arelorian.de A 2>&1")
print("DNS:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
